verdict.rationale: Inngest exposes an MCP server and CLI that let coding agents/AI clients inspect and operate Inngest (invoke functions, fetch traces) via natural-language-driven agent tools, and its REST API/CLI provide programmatic control, but there is no evidence of a native NL command interface (e.g., chat-based operation console) for end-users themselves — the natural-language operation is mediated entirely through third-party AI coding agents/MCP clients. missing for 10: first-party natural-language UI/chat surface for direct end-user commands, evidence of NL command parsing beyond MCP tool-calls, independent user reports confirming NL-driven operation.
